name: Yagisaka Kurouto
source:
He is a sadist with a strong body and mind and a strong desire for domination. He plans to resurrect the evil god “Orochi,” and is trying to surpass human beings by transforming them.

He is absolutely confident in himself and has a brutal personality, he enjoys training the sisters slowly and gradually.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/shimaimiko/index.html]official site[/url]]
